scope: Follow-up repairs for eleven named aircraft, plus an individual gauge-mounting review of all 53 aircraft.
methodology: Original deterministic procedural geometry, using manufacturer dimensions and available photographs as visual references. Existing procedural finishes and text atlases retained; no generated bitmap textures or copied photographic textures were added.

models.label: Airbus A320neo
changes: Rebuilt the nose around six straight-edged windscreen panes, including the distinctive upswept aft side panes. The glazing no longer wraps down across the nose.
Fitted the inner shell, floor, panel width and overhead to the nose; added a continuous glareshield deck to close the cavity behind the instruments.
Reduced and repositioned the nacelles and connected their pylons to the wing. Authored swept, tapered, closed sharklets with a curved transition, 2.43 m rise and 0.805 m outward extension.
Replaced the generic flight-guidance inscription with Airbus FCU control group labels and EFIS panels.
models.comparison: Airbus airport-planning dimensions and A320neo exterior photographs guided the overall proportions, engine placement and sharklets. A320-family cockpit photographs guided the glazing and FCU arrangement.

models.comparison: A220-300 exterior and CS300/A220 flight-deck references show four main windscreen panes and a longer, lower nose than the A320.

models.label: ATR 72-600
changes: Replaced the coarse roof-facet windshield opening with six separately fitted panes and a continuous nose skin.
Moved and narrowed the instrument panel to fit the nose; fitted its forward glare shield, side shelves and trim.

models.comparison: ATR flight-deck references show continuous gray wall trim surrounding the panel and side consoles. The new lining follows that enclosure instead of separate floating slabs.

models.label: Boeing 737-800
changes: Replaced the peaked front windshield with a nearly level brow and the Boeing six-pane arrangement, including the descending side-window sill.
Reshaped the radome and roof transition with a rounded tip and smooth longitudinal sections.
Kept the panel and glare shield inside the revised skin.
models.comparison: The real 737 does have an autopilot/flight-director Mode Control Panel (MCP) on the glareshield. Its controls and terminology differ from the A320 Flight Control Unit (FCU).

models.label: Cessna Citation CJ4
changes: Separated the exterior fuselage cross-section from the narrower cabin-width value used by the old generic airframe.
Rebuilt the nose and angular cockpit panes; replaced oval passenger windows with upright rounded rectangles.
Reduced the rear nacelles, tapered their exhaust sections and added horizontal attachment pylons reaching the fuselage.
Rebalanced the swept wing and T-tail, and fitted the cockpit floor, panel and overhead inside the smaller nose.
models.comparison: CJ4 Gen2 dimensions and CJ4 exterior photography guided the 16.26 m length, 15.49 m nominal span, small rear engines and upright cabin-window shape. The current Gen3 marketing page was not substituted for this variant.

targetedTests.command: node packages/entities/node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run test/aircraft-transport-fit.test.mjs test/aircraft-joins.test.mjs test/aircraft-instruments.test.mjs test/aircraft-interactions.test.mjs test/aircraft-atr72.test.mjs test/aircraft-beech18.test.mjs test/aircraft-dc3.test.mjs test/cockpit-lettering.test.mjs --root packages/entities --maxWorkers=1
targetedTests.environment: TEMP and TMP set to workspace test-tmp directory

checks: Source manifest, source GLB and imported GLB hashes
Finite attributes and transforms, valid triangle indices
Embedded texture dimensions and material bindings
Seven transport lower-cockpit enclosure rays, nacelle clearance, nominal span and glareshield containment
Closed sharklet skins and end caps
All supported cockpit controls remain pickable in all 53 source and imported aircraft

reproducibility.batchResult: 7615 GLBs built successfully; existing cache reused. Windows mapped-file write failures resolved by atomic manifest replacement in the airliner generator.
reproducibility.finalTargeted: All 41 revised aircraft regenerated from final source with identical source hashes; imported runtime hashes unchanged.

limitations: The cameras sample the model from fixed directions; this is not a mathematical proof that every possible camera pose is free of intersections.
The work improves silhouettes, cockpit enclosure and instrument mounting. Avionics remain simplified and unavailable systems keep their existing INOP indications.
References and full-size captures remain local in ignored .artifacts. This report records sources and current hashes; no assets were published and no Git mutations were performed.
